notes.title: Update v1.2 - Player slots and mini fixes
notes.content:
CURRENT BUG PLEASE BE AWARE THIS HAS NOT BEEN FIXED YET READ BEFORE PLAYING: if someone joins and then leaves and they try to rejoin it will instant crash them, the fix is to restart the game and join again it works


Update v1.2
Changelog:
- Amount of players per match has been fixed so you can get in a game with fully lobby of 5 or 6 people.
- Map game breaking glitches now patched.
- More map glitches fixed.
- Intro cutscene can now be skipped.

notes.title: Space of Retaliation Great Update & Fixes v1.1
notes.content:
Great Update & Fixes v1.1
- updated the distance for player names
- added Ray-Tracing support for RTX cards 
- improved lighting
- updated main menu 
- added Single-player support you can now play solo and host a match while others join
- updated the map added more detail with alien plants outside and other various details.
- moved the alarm to the center of the map lobby are
- Steam achievements added!
